options.content:
### Tray deep dive — `$node`
One GB300 tray at a time: CPU, memory, disk, network, adapters and its four GPUs, all from telemetry the tray pushes itself (`node_exporter`, `DCGM`). Pick the tray with the **Tray** variable above.

**Node area**  ·  [Tray roster — reporting, silent, per-rack coverage](/d/nvis-nodes-detail)  ·  [Host faults — filesystem, load, memory, kernel](/d/nvis-l2-node-deep-dive)  ·  **Tray deep dive (you are here)**  ·  [GPU health — XID, ECC, thermal, power](/d/gpu-health)

panels.description: GPUs on this tray currently reporting DCGM telemetry. The per-GPU table at the bottom of the board has exactly one row per GPU counted here.
panels.title: GPUs

panels.description: The `/` mount only. Every mount on this tray is listed in the filesystem table below.
panels.title: Root filesystem used

panels.description: Averaged across all CPU threads on this tray.
panels.title: CPU utilisation

panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal, so reclaimable page cache is not counted as used.
panels.title: Memory used

panels.description: Raw run-queue length. Divide by the tray's CPU-thread count (shown above) to compare trays.
panels.title: System load (1 / 5 / 15 min)

panels.description: Every mount this tray reports, including the shared NFS volumes. The `/` row is the number in the 'Root filesystem used' tile above.

defaults.noValue: This tray is not reporting filesystem metrics.

panels.title: Filesystems on tray $node — every mount

panels.description: Share of wall-clock time the device had at least one I/O in flight.
panels.title: Disk busy time

panels.description: One row per logical CPU on this tray. With the tray selected above, the row count is exactly the number in the 'CPU threads' tile. Percentages are the average over the last 5 minutes.

defaults.noValue: This tray is not reporting CPU counters.

panels.title: CPU cores on tray $node — busiest first (rows = the 'CPU threads' tile)

panels.description: node_exporter's view of this tray's own adapters — not switch telemetry. State 4 = ACTIVE. Link-down and port-error counts are lifetime counters.

defaults.noValue: This tray is not reporting adapter counters.

panels.title: Host adapters on tray $node — one row per port

panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL, raw DCGM counter. An idle tray reads 0 on every GPU — this only moves while a job is using NVLink.
panels.title: NVLink bandwidth (DCGM aggregate)

panels.description: One row per GPU on this tray — with the GPU variable left on All, the row count is the number in the 'GPUs' tile above. 'Last XID' is the most recent code the driver reported for that GPU with its own text; blank means the driver has reported none.

defaults.noValue: This tray is not reporting DCGM metrics.

panels.title: Per-GPU snapshot on tray $node — the exact GPUs behind the 'GPUs' tile

list.description: One tray at a time — every panel on this board is scoped to it.
